routes.name: VTNZ Glen Innes - Full Licence Motorway & Highway Circuit
routes.overview: The full licence practical test route testing high-speed driving, motorway on-ramp merging, hazard identification and verbal commentary at 80 km/h and 100 km/h around Glen Innes.
key_maneuvers: Motorway on-ramp acceleration and 100 km/h merging
Verbal hazard detection: identifying hazards and stating driving actions
Motorway deceleration ramp braking technique
Multi-lane arterial lane changing at 60 - 80 km/h
examiner_tips: In the Full test, you must state what hazards you see AND what you are doing about them (e.g. 'Car reversing from driveway on left - watching for movement and keeping safety buffer').
On the motorway on-ramp, accelerate with conviction so your speed matches highway traffic before you reach the solid line break.
Do not begin braking for an off-ramp until your vehicle is fully inside the deceleration lane.
